facts.intervention: Alteration of occlusal vertical dimension in restorative treatment
facts.main_result: OVD is a dynamic dimension within a zone of physiological tolerance and should be changed minimally, only when a clinical demand exists.
facts.funding_coi: No conflicts of interest and no financial support reported
facts.key_finding: The review concludes that occlusal vertical dimension is a flexible parameter within a zone of physiological tolerance, to be altered only when clinically needed and by the minimum necessary amount.
facts.clinical_bottom_line: Confirm a clinical demand before changing OVD, keep the change minimal, and use provisionals to test esthetic and functional outcomes.
